summary: ooClickId/ooSetValue touch only the ids the markup names (ratchet holds the sets equal to the bound ids); GESTURE_ONLY names (secureErase, removeAuthor, removeAnnotation, removeUserCalendar, removeDraftItem) run only for isTrusted click or Enter/Space; encryptCorpus, saveFetchMode, saveDiscoveryExternal, ingestUrl and importCustomFeed read their fields from the pressed control's panel and the first three plus secureErase confirm first (4 prompts x12); ooOpenUrl resolves with new URL and refuses backslash paths; /api/safety/secure-erase answers 400 before a panic in this process and 409 while one runs; the owed mechanism is removed from the take-before-try guard; scripts/run_scale_bench.py and scripts/generate_scale_corpus.py no longer accept a passphrase on argv (the two flags are kept only to be refused by name; values come from OO_DB_PASSPHRASE / OO_BENCH_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE or standard input; the generator's flag is --passphrase; an unrecognized argument is counted, never printed, because argparse prints it back).
